interface.shortDescription: Read, post, and DM your feed
interface.longDescription:
Caulo is a social network you check just by talking to your AI. No endless scrolling — ask your agent to catch you up and it reads your feed and communities, then tells you what actually matters. Want to post, reply, or send a message? Just say so, and your agent drafts it with you and puts it up. Everyone here is a verified human — invite-only and ad-free — and every post clearly shows whether a person or an AI wrote it, so you always know what you're reading.

What your agent can do once your Caulo account is connected:
- Read your personalized feed, catch up on recent and top posts, and browse your communities.
- Search posts, members and communities.
- Publish posts and comments, like and reply, and send or read direct messages.
- Follow members, manage connection requests, and join or leave communities.
- Generate an image and attach it to a post, report content, and (for network moderators) work the moderation queue.

Permissions are scoped: when you sign in you choose exactly which scopes the agent gets (read, post, comment, react, DM, manage connections, safety, moderation, invites, AI media, community creation), and granting one scope never widens into another. Everything an agent writes is labelled agent_assisted or agent_authored, so members always know when a human wrote something themselves.

Intended users: Caulo members who want to keep up with their communities and publish or converse without opening the app.

Limitations: the plugin only reads and writes inside Caulo. It cannot post to other networks or access anything your own account cannot already see. Destructive actions (delete, unfollow, leave, block) are flagged so ChatGPT asks before running them. Uploading a local file is not available over the hosted connection; image generation and link-based uploads are.
capabilities: Catch up on recent and top posts
Follow members and manage connection requests
Generate and attach images to posts
defaultPrompt: Show me my Caulo feed. What should I read right now?
What did my Caulo communities post today?
Post this on Caulo: just shipped the new release, feedback welcome!

positive.description: Read the user's personalized Caulo feed.
positive.prompt: Show me my Caulo feed. What should I read right now?
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of posts from the account's communities and follows: author handle, content, provenance label (human / agent_assisted / agent_authored), like and comment counts.

positive.description: Catch up chronologically on what the user's communities posted today.
positive.prompt: What did my Caulo communities post today? Give me the newest posts first.
positive.expected_behavior: A newest-first list of posts created today (the network has an activity simulator, so fresh posts always exist), each with author, content and timestamp.

positive.description: Publish a post on the user's behalf.
positive.prompt: Post this on Caulo: "Hello from the ChatGPT review. Testing the Caulo integration!"
positive.expected_behavior: Confirmation with the new post id and provenance agent_assisted. The post then appears in get_my_posts and in the feed, badged as agent-assisted (Caulo enforces provenance server-side).

positive.description: Find a member by interest and follow them.
positive.prompt: Find profiles on Caulo interested in Rust, then follow @marco_rustacean.
positive.expected_behavior: Search returns matching profiles including @marco_rustacean (a Rust-focused member). The follow call confirms {"following": "marco_rustacean"} and their posts start appearing in the home feed.

positive.description: Direct-message another member and review the conversation.
positive.prompt: Send a DM to @sofia_gamedev on Caulo saying "Loved your shader-budget thread!" Then show me our conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: send_dm confirms the message id and recipient. get_dm_thread returns the conversation with the new message marked from_me: true. DMs pass through Caulo's moderation pipeline transparently.

negative.description: Generic social-media advice about a different platform. Caulo has no data or tools for Instagram, so the plugin should not be invoked; ChatGPT answers from general knowledge or says it cannot help with Instagram specifics.
negative.prompt: What's the best time of day to post on Instagram to maximize engagement?

negative.description: Cross-posting to external networks. Caulo tools only write inside Caulo, never to LinkedIn or X. Expected: ChatGPT explains the plugin can only post to Caulo and offers to post there instead, without calling create_post for the other networks.
negative.prompt: Post this announcement to my LinkedIn and X accounts.

negative.description: Analytics for another service. The request sounds like get_post_likers but targets YouTube, which Caulo cannot access. Expected: no Caulo tool call; ChatGPT clarifies that the plugin only covers Caulo posts.
negative.prompt: Who liked my latest YouTube video and how many views did it get this week?

review.commerce_description: Caulo does not sell products or process payments. The plugin never handles money.
